profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Palo Alto Networks
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer, mostly web stuff. Seasoned Pythonista. Aspiring Rustacean. Good at database modeling, Javascript, React, etc. Average at systems design. Bad at vertically aligning stuff in CSS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Contributor to the main core/e-commerce platform.
* Contributed to the core backend logic to support A/B experiments on pricing schemes for new onboarding users.
* Contributed with small incremental improvements to the codebase that had a great effect in development speed, impacting the team’s local/offline development environments and the existing test suite’s execution speed.
* Part of the effort to upgrade to the latest version of the Django framework.
positions.insights: Skills: Django · Python (Programming Language) · Django REST Framework

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core contributor to several Python-based products and Web-based monitoring tools and dashboards.

* Contributor to the ShadowControl monitoring/management tool; an appliance type product designed to manage several ShadowProtect and ImageManager instances in small/medium business environments.
- Legacy code maintenance
- Contribution of new features
- Lead the effort to move away from server-rendered pages to highly dynamic web-based interfaces implemented using a React/Redux setup backed by a REST API
- Lead the effort to move the codebase from Python 2 to Python 3

* Part of the design, architecture and implementation team of a new product
- Develop and design critical features in both the backend (Flask, GraphQL, SQLAlchemy) and the frontend (React/Relay)
- Help the team decide the technologies to use and where/how to use them
- Due to the lack of senior, high quality frontend engineers in the area and that the team already had a good amount of great Python developers, I decided it would be best for the team that I would focus most of my work on the frontend side of the product so the team could move faster and stop wasting time in hiring rounds.

* Part of the effort to enforce linting and other analysis tools on every pull request, I was in charge of putting together the company-wide Javascript style guide and development process guidelines.
* Developed an internal prototype tool to scan a codebase’s dependencies (for Python and NPM/Yarn projects) to check for licences types and alert about dependencies with incompatible licence types (like GPL).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Core contributor to the video streaming platform ecosystem, developing apps and small systems that leverage on the core platform to deliver extra value and showcase the platform potential
* Part of the effort to move the customer admin panel from server-side rendered pages to a full-featured REST API paired with a highly dynamic single page application.
* Part of the effort to generate high quality documentation for the REST API, documentation to be consumed by the company’s clients
* Designed, implemented and deployed a TV-guide like web application, that using the core video platform, allowed clients to define “stations” and schedule any type of content (video on demand, live video, audio) to be played at fixed times, like a TV schedule. In addition to be able to define several stations, an embed code can be generated for a specific station, allowing customer to embed this dynamic content into their own websites.
